# Counter

Displays a compact count for badges, filters, unread items, and status summaries.

- **Import:** `import { Counter } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-counter--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Counter, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function CounterExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Counter>2</Counter>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Counter

It forwards its ref to `HTMLSpanElement`. Its props are `CounterProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, VariantProps<typeof counterVariants>`.

- `emotion`: `Emotion`, optional.

  What the count means. Leave it unset and `tone` renders exactly as it
  always has. Set it and the emotion decides the colour — a counter is
  always a filled pill, so there is one treatment rather than two.

  The product drives this axis on 9,427 counter instances across 11
  surfaces. `tone` stays for the two values that are not emotions at all:
  `inverse`, and a `brand` that predates the axis.

- `size`: `"sm" | "default" | null`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `tone`: `"destructive" | "neutral" | "brand" | "inverse" | null`, optional, default `"neutral"`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### Emotion

From `@kozmos-ds/react`, which does not export it by name.

```ts
type Emotion = (typeof EMOTIONS)[number];
```
